g.text: Each point is the 14 days (sizes) or 7 days (causes) ending on it, fewer at the start. A size line needs 5 merged PRs in its window.
n = PRs behind the last point. Dashed = 6 or more files, recorded before 6, 7 and 8+ were split.
Tiles: the last 7 days, change on the 7 before. Causes are labelled by a model from each fix run's report.
Data: factory.json "quality", summed over every orchestrator host.
